title: Offline payment approval claims the transaction, then writes back a status the claim accepts again

bugs.note: approveTransaction takes the row with the conditional UPDATE to processing, and then sets and flushes approved before settling. The same change adds approved to the statuses claimForProcessing accepts, so a second admin request (double click, second tab) arriving while the first is still settling claims the row again and settles the same offline payment a second time: the invoice is paid or the client credited twice.
